detail.longDescription: Anyone using crowdsec know how to trigger a permanent ban? I have a bunch of AI scrapers I never want to see unbanned. I want them permanently banned. Likewise when literal extreme bad actors show up to my servers, I don't want to see them ever get access to anything, not even after 4h or whatever. I run the Traefik CrowdSec Bouncer on K8s btw. I'm also using SecLang rules ported over from modSecurity if that matters :100_shrug: # crowdsec # waf # kubernetes # waf # docker # owasp # corza
